
	<div class="postTitle">
		<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/28Blog/p/19222284" title="发布于 2025-11-14 15:31">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Nessus 10.8.5 在 Ubuntu 22.04 下的完整配置指南（含激活与突破 16IP 扫描限制）</span>
    

</a>

	</div>
	    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3717091/202511/3717091-20251114153121716-1204407870.png" alt="Nessus 10.8.5 在 Ubuntu 22.04 下的完整配置指南（含激活与突破 16IP 扫描限制）" class="desc_img">
        本文详细介绍了 Nessus 10.8.5 在 Ubuntu 22.04 系统下的完整配置流程，涵盖从安装到突破限制的全步骤。首先需上传安装包并通过dpkg命令安装，启动服务后通过http://IP:8834完成 Web 端基础配置；接着重点讲解离线激活操作，包括获取 Challenge Code 与 Activation Code、上传许可证并导入插件；最后说明创建扫描任务的方法，同时提供突破基础版 16 个 IP 扫描限制的方案，解决了 Nessus 默认无插件、扫描范围受限的核心问题，适用于需要在 Ubuntu 环境下使用 Nessus 进行漏洞扫描的场景。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="nessus-安装与配置指南ubuntu-2204">Nessus 安装与配置指南（Ubuntu 22.04）</h2>
<h3 id="准备工作">准备工作</h3>
<ol>
<li>操作系统：Ubuntu 22.04</li>
<li>下载安装包：<code>Nessus-10.8.5-ubuntu1604_amd64.deb</code></li>
</ol>
<p><a href="https://cloud.kong.college/s/bKC9" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">漏扫工具Nessus-10.8.5-ubuntu1604_amd64.deb</a><br>
<a href="https://cloud.kong.college/s/NghQ" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Ubuntu 22.0.4</a></p>
<h3 id="安装-nessus">安装 Nessus</h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p>将下载的安装包上传至Ubuntu服务器</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>执行安装命令：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">dpkg -i Nessus-10.8.5-ubuntu1604_amd64.deb
</code></pre>
<p><img src="http://markdown.kong.college/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&amp;sign=d0f31d053a6fc46df22a867e7fb36eac" alt="安装过程截图" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>启动Nessus服务：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">systemctl start nessusd
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>访问Web控制台：<br>
通过 <code>http://服务器IP:8834</code> 访问，按以下顺序配置：</p>
<ul>
<li>勾选 <code>Register offline</code></li>
<li>选择 <code>managed scanner</code></li>
<li>选择 <code>tenable.sc</code></li>
<li>设定管理员账号密码</li>
<li>等待初始化完成</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="http://markdown.kong.college/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&amp;sign=dbae2a127a6607f34847baf9942efae8" alt="初始化完成截图" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="登录后注意事项">登录后注意事项</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>默认情况下，Nessus未安装任何插件，需手动激活并导入插件。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="激活-nessus">激活 Nessus</h3>
<h4 id="步骤1获取-challenge-code">步骤1：获取 Challenge Code</h4>
<ol>
<li>访问<a href="https://plugins.nessus.org/v2/offline.php" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">插件获取页面</a></li>
<li>执行命令生成Challenge Code：<pre><code class="language-bash">/opt/nessus/sbin/nessuscli fetch --challenge
</code></pre>
<img src="http://markdown.kong.college/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&amp;sign=3cb9f7656cbd65bae4ca246ec9ddb86a" alt="Challenge Code生成结果" loading="lazy"></li>
</ol>
<h4 id="步骤2获取-activation-code">步骤2：获取 Activation Code</h4>
<ol>
<li>
<p>访问<a href="https://www.tenable.com/products/nessus/nessus-essentials" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">激活码获取页面</a><br>
<img src="http://markdown.kong.college/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&amp;sign=f64ea461f54561be3540812088ceffe9" alt="Activation Code获取页面" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>在插件获取页面填写信息：</p>
<ul>
<li>第一个输入框：填入离线获取的<code>Challenge code</code></li>
<li>第二个输入框：填入在线获取的<code>activation code</code><br>
<img src="http://markdown.kong.college/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&amp;sign=46f9b25887145ef925c23088b248e903" alt="信息填写页面" loading="lazy"></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>完成后会获取到：</p>
<ul>
<li>激活许可证（LICENSE）</li>
<li>插件下载地址（如<a href="https://plugins.nessus.org/v2/nessus.php?f=all-2.0.tar.gz&amp;u=9d8313aab88661974dc4b681aaf90042&amp;p=0982ec81c16fd58a073901aab99bc4f4" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">插件地址</a>）<br>
<img src="http://markdown.kong.college/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&amp;sign=304eac53d9fb782799183cb7d5519517" alt="获取结果截图" loading="lazy"></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h4 id="步骤3上传并配置许可证与插件">步骤3：上传并配置许可证与插件</h4>
<ol>
<li>
<p>将获取到的<code>LICENSE</code>文件和插件压缩包（<code>all-2.0.tar.gz</code>）上传至服务器<br>
<img src="http://markdown.kong.college/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&amp;sign=c7dd61c36c93477bad9725f10456ee60" alt="文件上传截图" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>离线激活Nessus：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">/opt/nessus/sbin/nessuscli fetch --register-offline ./nessus.license
</code></pre>
<p><img src="http://markdown.kong.college/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&amp;sign=4a7ca81e56a510698b0f90df71e7e2f9" alt="激活结果截图" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>导入插件：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">/opt/nessus/sbin/nessuscli update all-2.0.tar.gz
</code></pre>
<p><img src="http://markdown.kong.college/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&amp;sign=eff01c0ab3f2141e95427349d74cf6f8" alt="插件导入截图" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>重启Nessus服务：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">systemctl restart nessusd
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：需等待插件安装完成后再进行后续操作<br>
<img src="http://markdown.kong.college/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&amp;sign=0fc851fc2d4043d909acfbaf4ce701cc" alt="插件安装完成截图" loading="lazy"></p>
</blockquote>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="创建扫描任务">创建扫描任务</h3>
<ol>
<li>登录Web控制台后，按照指引创建扫描任务<br>
<img src="http://markdown.kong.college/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&amp;sign=f1b7c4922ae9519525fa392aaaa6b115" alt="创建扫描截图" loading="lazy"></li>
</ol>
<h3 id="突破16个ip扫描限制">突破16个IP扫描限制</h3>
<p>默认基础版Nessus仅支持扫描16个IP，可按以下步骤突破限制：<br>
<img src="http://markdown.kong.college/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&amp;sign=a891c69233d9865c24e52a1e698e603f" alt="限制提示截图" loading="lazy"></p>
<h4 id="步骤1停止nessus服务">步骤1：停止Nessus服务</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">systemctl stop nessusd.service
</code></pre>
<h4 id="步骤2创建配置文件">步骤2：创建配置文件</h4>
<ol>
<li>
<p>创建<code>plugin_feed_info.inc</code>文件：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">touch plugin_feed_info.inc
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>编辑文件内容（注意<code>PLUGIN_SET</code>需与最新插件版本匹配）：</p>
<pre><code class="language-plaintext">PLUGIN_SET = "202509301708";  # 需替换为实际的插件版本号
PLUGIN_FEED = "ProfessionalFeed (Direct)";
PLUGIN_FEED_TRANSPORT = "Tenable Network Security Lightning"; 
</code></pre>
<p><img src="http://markdown.kong.college/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&amp;sign=c2fb6cf3d999e8bcdeb3e689d45ee0fa" alt="配置文件内容截图" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>如何获取<code>PLUGIN_SET</code>值？参考截图中的版本信息<br>
<img src="http://markdown.kong.college/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&amp;sign=184a617e61d6ffde3e898b8561737a19" alt="PLUGIN_SET获取截图" loading="lazy"></p>
</blockquote>
</li>
</ol>
<h4 id="步骤3替换配置文件">步骤3：替换配置文件</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cp plugin_feed_info.inc /opt/nessus/var/nessus/plugin_feed_info.inc
</code></pre>
<h4 id="步骤4启动nessus服务">步骤4：启动Nessus服务</h4>
<pre><code class="language-bash">systemctl start nessusd
</code></pre>

</div>
